data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Isleen is the goddess of the sea, often depicted as a mermaid or a sea nymph. Her name derives from the Greek word 'isos' meaning 'equal' and 'leon' meaning 'lion', symbolizing her power and strength. The name Isleen carries the meaning “Goddess of the sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
